notes_en: Fix: Quran surah list now shows all 114 surahs (was hardcoded to 10). SurahListPage fetches /surahs from the API and falls back to a bundled 114-surah list when offline. Also fixed SurahModel 'name' field mapping (backend has no guaranteed 'name' key) so getSurahs() no longer throws. Reader still seeds sample ayahs so it is never blank while loading.
notes_ur: درست: قرآن کی فہرست اب 114 سورہ دکھاتی ہے (پہلے 10 تھیں)۔
notes_hi: Fix: Quran surah list ab 114 surahs dikhata hai (pehle 10 thi).
